content: We now have the #Editors & UIs> channel -- are you all interested in combining this channel into there (I think there's value in each of us seeing what's happening with other editor environments and getting ideas from each other, which is why I subscribe here, but it'd be even easier if we were all there I think)
I think that it makes sense. Also, we should probably find another maintainer for the lean mode. I was failing to find time for this for months.

Yury G. Kudryashov wrote:

we should probably find another maintainer for the lean mode

I agree! Unfortunately, Lean-for-Emacs has become a landscape of
forks rather than a single package.

  • Deprecated lean(3)-mode

  • leanprover-community/lean4-mode

  • Paul Nelson's fork

  • Richard Copley's fork

  • Lua's lean-ts-mode (which uses tree-sitter and, if I remember
    correctly, websockets and JavaScript for ‘info view’)

  • Mekeor's Nael (which works with both lsp-mode and Eglot but has
    removed the custom implementation of ‘info view’ in favor of
    ElDoc; also sublicensed under GPLv3+, copyright partly assigned
    to FSF)

Ideally, we should join forces.
